audit.whatIsWrong: content.whys[0], content.whys[1], content.spikes[0].text and content.early all say Milio's Q (Ultra Mega Fire Kick) cleanses/heals the knockup from Alistar's W-Q combo. Milio's Q is an offensive knockback/slow ball with no cleanse or heal effect. The cleanse-and-heal-CC ability is his R, Breath of Life (per ownerKit R text: 'heal and remove crowd control effects from allies in range'), which is not available until level 6.
audit.why: This is a fabricated mechanic shipped as fact: a reader leveling Q expecting it to save their ADC from Headbutt-Pulverize at level 1-2 will be wrong every time. Milio has no CC-cleanse before level 6.
audit.corrected: Reworded whys[0]/whys[1]/spikes[0].text/early to credit Milio's actual early tools — Q's knockback/slow and E's (Warm Hugs) shield charges — for the level 1-3 edge, and left the level-6 ult-cleanse claim (spikes[1].text, which already correctly names R Breath of Life) untouched.
sources: ownerKit Q/E/R ability text in brief
